name: Voxel Ray Traversal (AABB-optimized)
definition: An iterator that traverses a 3D voxel volume along a ray, returning hits for voxels contained within the volume. It uses an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) test to quickly reject rays that do not intersect the volume before performing the voxel traversal.
summary: Voxel Ray Traversal (AABB-optimized) efficiently enumerates voxels in flat volumes by using an AABB test to skip empty space before standard DDA iteration.
